craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Rehousing: locked/curbed kept both — confinement moved indoors to supreme self; even-there hinge. Rejected: (a) resolving locked vs curbed → killed: both kept, both trace. (b) dwells→abides → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: THOUGH-things STAND-locked IN the-LIV-ing … IN the-su-PREME-self IT-dwells.

lines: Though things stand locked in the living,
by breath and eightfold-city curbed — even there, in the supreme self it dwells.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yady apy arthasthitiḥ prāṇapuryaṣṭakaniyantrite jīve niruddhā tatrāpi paramātmani sā sthitā

reads_against.argmap: Does the confined order escape the self? → Confinement is rehoused: even locked order abides in the supreme self.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
